package.name: team13_nav
package.description: Team 13 (DroneHacks 2026) autonomy on the skybeta contract: the organizers' flight_interface (unchanged), a stereo-depth node (OAK left/right -> SGBM depth) and the official-stack mission node in io:=skybeta mode. Talks to the vehicle only through /skybeta/setpoint/pose; reads /skybeta/state, cuVSLAM and /fmu/out.
